title: Ultracode worth it when you are close to reset ?
author: Upbeat-Mail7201
selftext:
So I'm pretty close to my weekly reset of Claude tokens but even though it worked for 4 days without a break im at 53%. It will reset in 3h, shall I try to use ultracode for once for a refactoring and documention update task to burn through the unused tokens ? 



Or is it a waste and not worth it at all ? Never tried ultracode usually only using extra high or high.

comments.author: alvoliooo
comments.body: It’s good at some things, worse at others. Ask Claude what it’s best at then go for it. Burn those tokens

comments.author: Claude_human_4271
comments.body: Just put fable to work to write fanfiction, the output tokens will guarantee a full burn

replies.author: Charming_You_25
replies.body: Harry slowly removes his robe and wizard hat, smiling sheepishly at Draco

comments.author: Charming_You_25
comments.body:
Maybe. I’m not sure because I never use it but last time I checked the benches fable high was generally better and didn’t overthink. I’d just open up multiple fable threads all working on backlog or long running playtests stress testing looking for bugs.

One thing I do is to have fable make a list of assumed claims about the game (“I can make a new account, then I can start a new game, then I can get through the tutorial, then I can gather wood, then I can make troops, then I can attack. Then I can win”) and have browser tests verify all of them, as well as have the playtests grow the list through play. (“Given info presented, what do you assume you can do? Now check”). Test both general/long running claims (I can make an account and play, I can win this game, I can lose this game) and atomic claims (I can click the new game button and a new game starts).

replies.author: Upbeat-Mail7201
replies.body: Switching to fable will increase token usages so much just to switch they would be at 70% before it even starts

comments.author: Livid_Shallot5701
comments.body: i do a lot with xhigh. im wondering, im having a huge rework this week, if i should switch to ultra  for it, but im scared it eats my tokens after two days or smth

replies.author: Charming_You_25
replies.body: I wouldn’t. I prefer high anyways unless I’m expecting a massive reply (like a big plan).

replies.author: Upbeat-Mail7201
replies.body:
I just tried it it wasn't so bad it has done everything it was supposed to do and is now at 74% and still 2h until weekly reset... 


I use fable now need to waste these tokens lol

comments.author: toroidalvoid
comments.body: I think you can use ultracode at a specific level now, give it a go and see what happens

replies.author: Upbeat-Mail7201
replies.body: Worked great and still didn't burned all tokens haha

comments.author: discomonk
comments.body: If you're about to lose 53% in 3 hours you can't exactly waste that usage by putting it to work. It'll definitely be able to burn through that if you allow it to and have worked lined up for it.

comments.author: Fuzzzy420
comments.body:
You can use Ultracode with medium context. Yes it's worth it. For simple tasks it's overkill but for anything else it's a Godsend.
Be aware that if you spam in Ultracode you will burn up your tokens fast. Don't use xhigh. 

 I use Claude with codex and anti-gravity and Ultracode deligates to both of them as needed just as Claude's own agents which saves tokens. And yes you could turn it off and tell Claude to delegate but it's not the same. Ultracode has some sort of multi agent pipeline built in.

comments.author: Haunting-Frosting417
comments.body: Do y’all only change models on Claude or do y’all build agents?

replies.author: Upbeat-Mail7201
replies.body: Both in parallel, depending on the tasks. Have 17 parallel QA testing and documentation bots and 12 for debugging and reports

comments.author: Turbulent-Upstairs47
comments.body: I'd do the docs part with it, but be careful with the refactor. If you hit the limit halfway through, you're stuck with a half-changed codebase until reset. Branch first and have it commit in small chunks, so whatever it finishes is actually usable.

replies.author: Upbeat-Mail7201
replies.body: Always working in smaller batches anyway with several commits between and Autocompact

comments.author: PositiveScarcity8909
comments.body: I don't know what kind of plan you guys at, my $20 plan doesn't last me 3 days and I'm only using medium effort.

comments.author: WiredBrew
comments.body: Ultracode was made before agents could communicate with one another (effectively turning all sessions in team agent sessions) and as a result is actively worse than just asking Claude to split the task between agents when it can. It loses a lot of functionality when it constantly drops context between the agents it's generating and it affects quality as a result. I would just use Max instead.
